record.title: Observe the current stock epoch through one owned Linux ADB session
record.intent: Establish whether ordinary ADB can provide the stock evidence required for resumed RF acquisition.
requirements: Execute the reviewed fresh standard-client invocation once under actual namespace/capture/lease guards. No repeated failed connect or ambiguous command retry. Read UID first; insufficient access or a failed recorder/client stops without root restart or reboot.

Preserve actual boot/process, APK/native map and hashes, protected-content hashes, normal UI screenshot and the bounded existing observer result if all preceding identity/mapping gates pass. Classify missing evidence honestly. No RF source command, waveform, ordinary setting change, native selection, entitlement, calibration or wiring transition is included.

Retire the positively owned ADB server and capture with recorded graceful results/drop statistics. Preserve actual socket states without claiming TIME_WAIT absence. Keep the existing network namespace isolated; no external route or host security changes. Seal evidence independently of the link checkpoint and keep stock originals byte-identical.
acceptance: One current stock-state observation is sealed or its exact failed prerequisite is preserved without broadening.
